children: Caesars Palace is welcoming one of the best bars in the world this fall in tandem with the resort’s 60th anniversary celebrations. Known for its outstanding mixology, carefully selected ingredients and clever presentation, SIPS Drinkery House will take over VISTA Cocktail Lounge from Oct. 31 through Dec. 31 and give guests the sip of a lifetime. Based in Barcelona’s famed Eixample neighborhood, SIPS is “
an experience full of technique, creativity and no barriers…
” (Condé Nast Traveler), where
“serious cocktails are served in unserious forms”
(Tasting Table).
*For high-res images, click

“For six decades, Caesars Palace has set the stage for world-class hospitality and unforgettable experiences guests cannot find anywhere else,” said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President of Caesars Entertainment. “As we celebrate this milestone year, our partnership with SIPS unites one of the world's most influential cocktail destinations with one of the most iconic resorts on The Strip. The collaboration reflects our commitment to continually introducing innovative experiences while staying true to the timeless spirit that has defined Caesars Palace for generations.”

Named The World's Best Bar by The World’s 50 Best Bars 2023, SIPS has remained among the industry's elite, ranking No.3 globally in both 2024 and 2025 while earning recognition as The Best Bar in Europe. Founded by bartenders Simone Caporale and Marc Álvarez in 2021, SIPS reimagines the cocktail experience by putting flavor first. Built on the belief that glassware and presentation should elevate, not distract from, the drink itself, the Barcelona bar combines innovative technique and familiar flavors to deliver memorable cocktails.

“Knowing that an iconic global institution like Caesars Palace recognizes the excellent hospitality and cocktail creativity of an independent bar in Barcelona proves that what’s made with purpose will be remembered by many,” said Simone Caporale, Co-Founder of SIPS. “We're so excited to bring SIPS to Caesars Palace and translate the cocktail experience into great memories in Las Vegas.”
At VISTA Cocktail Lounge, guests can enjoy signature cocktails from Barcelona that showcase SIPS’ flavor-first philosophy and distinctive approach to presentation. The
Purple Rain,
an elegant, modern take on a whiskey sour, features bourbon mellowed with wild sour honey and beetroot. For a refreshing option, the
Mosaic
combines pisco brandy with aromatic woods from the Amazon rainforest and is served in a painted glass reminiscent of Barcelona’s modernist art movement.

VISTA Cocktail Lounge is near Amalfi by Bobby Flay and Dominique Ansel Las Vegas inside Caesars Palace. VISTA is open Monday through Thursday from 2 p.m. to 2 a.m., and Friday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. For more information or to make a reservation, guests can visit

About SIPS Drinkery House

SIPS Drinkery House is an award-winning cocktail destination in Barcelona, founded by renowned bartenders Simone Caporale and Marc Álvarez. Redefining the traditional cocktail bar experience, SIPS combines cutting-edge mixology, innovative presentation, and exceptional hospitality within an open environment designed to bring guests and bartenders closer together. The venue is built around the philosophy of elevating the drinking experience through creativity, flavour, and craftsmanship. Located in Barcelona's Eixample district, SIPS has earned international recognition as one of the world's leading bars, celebrated for its pioneering approach to cocktail culture and guest experience.
About Caesars Palace

Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and suites, including the redesigned 182-room Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace, the renovated Colosseum Tower and THE VILLAS Caesars Palace, which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Josh Groban and Tim McGraw. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
